# Confirm restoring multiple saved items keeps their full details and order

## What & Why
The current restore regression covers one answer and one opportunity. Testing multiple entries would catch collection-level regressions that accidentally drop metadata or change ordering while still passing the single-item case.

## Done looks like
- Restore a workspace containing multiple answers and opportunities
- Verify each answer's title, category, and content after reload
- Verify each opportunity's company, role, status, priority, notes, next action, and list order after reload

- artifacts/escape-hatch/tests/persistence.spec.ts
- artifacts/escape-hatch/src/lib/storage.ts
